scope: Serial Mac standalone tests on 120 Hz built-in display with generated native tracker inputs, one or four rigs, six 128x128 on-screen LED views per rig. All cases reported Application.isFocused=false; no foreground, 60 Hz output, physical LED or camera-exposure timing certification. Existing unrelated background work was not terminated. Profiler LastValue and FrameTiming may lag callback frames; GC correlation uses raw per-frame collection deltas with a +/-1 frame window. Initial isolation aggregate GC counts may include summary allocations; followup source freezes totals before reporting.
